# D24 inline shoulder roll vs the belt roll (generated by `python -m rnd.roll_inline`)

python -m rnd.roll_inline dome                              # belt dome (the default drive)
    PIP_ROLL_DRIVE=inline python -m rnd.roll_inline <check>     # check ∈ dome, assembly_seq, spacing, swept, dexterity, basket

The CAD and the twin read params.ROLL_DRIVE at import, so each drive is a separate run. Results go to
docs/rnd/roll_inline.json (one entry per drive and check) and docs/rnd/roll_inline.md; the baseline reports
(assembly_seq.md, swept.md, ...) are not touched. Run one heavy check at a time.

| Check | belt (GIM6010-8 + 18T:80T) | inline (GIM8108-36) |
|---|---|---|
| Shoulder dome, fore-aft × height (mm), CAD | 163 × 219 (slim-study ESTIMATE 172 × 210) | 117 × 100 (slim-study ESTIMATE 128 × 120) |
| Dome reach outboard of the detach plane (mm) | 153 | 120 |
| ROLL_Y / yaw_drop (mm) | 83.0 / 116.0 | 70.0 / 103.9 |
| Roll / yaw stage mass, CAD (kg, actuator not included) | 0.72 / 0.57 | 0.28 / 0.55 |
| R14 assembly sequence, roll row | ✅ (5/7 shafts) | ✅ (5/7 shafts) |
| R15 spacing, roll/yaw module (under target / hard) | 2 / 0 ✅ | 1 / 0 ✅ |
| R15 swept: min gap roll / yaw (mm); pairs under target / hard | 0.7 / 2.0; 0 / 0 ✅ | 0.4 / 2.3; 0 / 0 ✅ |
| R16 dexterity: top-down / 45° / side / across | 34% / 70% / 65% / 52% ❌ | 35% / 72% / 65% / 62% ✅ |
| R2d basket: worst duty margin; roll peak margin | 1.46; 34.3× ✅ | 1.48; 52.5× ✅ |

Spacing pairs under target (belt):

- yaw_block ↔ yaw_shaft (moving) 2.0 mm (target 2.0)
- yaw_flange ↔ yaw_stop_pin (running) 0.3 mm (target 0.3)

Spacing pairs under target (inline):

- yaw_flange ↔ yaw_stop_pin (running) 0.3 mm (target 0.3)
